incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — p99 latency breach on prod-serving cluster (route: /v1/generate). p99 > 2.5s, p95 rising. start=3470001200. Severity: sev2. Alert ID: A-2026-3470. Link: https://alerts.internal/redwood/A-2026-3470

maya: seeing streaming stalls in the dashboard — sessions that used to stream tokens now hang mid-stream. p95 ~1.3s, p99 ~3.2s.

dylan: checking kv-cache metrics now. shard-12 mem at 94%, eviction rate spiked 6x since 3469999xxx deploy. suspect fragmentation + eviction storms.

dylan: metrics snippet:
```
kv_shard_mem_used_bytes{shard="12"} 0.94
kv_evictions_total{shard="12"} 6123
prefill_tasks_active 48 -> 220 (5m)
decode_workers_busy_ratio 0.9
```

sanjay: note we rolled out prefill-allocator change at 3469999000 to improve prefill throughput — might be overscheduling prefill on decode hosts.

eva: customer impact? which tenants affected? should we page any A customers? :eyes: 

maya: AcmeCorp chat sessions show streaming stalls in ~6% of requests, BetaAnalytics embedding flows show tail latency and retries. Not full failures — degraded perf and some timeouts for long streams.

dylan: quick mitigation plan (tiered):
1) Turn off active prefill on memory-constrained hosts.
2) Force LRU eviction policy + reduce cache TTL for 20m -> 5m to reduce fragmentation.
3) Scale decode-workers 4 -> 8 for short term.
4) Route high-latency traffic to smaller model variant (fallback).
5) Restart problematic kv-shard pods one at a time to defragment.

katie: I'll run the prefill disable on prod now (will annotate in deploy log):
```bash
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/kv-prefill PREFILL_ENABLED=false --record
```

dylan: good. also apply manual autoscaler override so it doesn't immediately scale down decode after we finish:
```bash
kubectl -n prod annotate deployment/decode-workers autoscaler.k8s.alpha/override="manual-locked" --overwrite
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/decode-workers --replicas=8
```

incident-bot: Note: automated scaling policy is still active. If you set manual override, confirm in the autoscale UI to prevent immediate revert.

sanjay: pulling live metrics after katie's env change... one sec.

sanjay: live scrape (post-disable):
```
kv_shard_mem_used_bytes{shard="12"} 0.89
kv_evictions_total{shard="12"} 6170 (+47 in 2m)
prefill_tasks_active 220 -> 28
decode_workers_busy_ratio 0.6
streaming_stall_rate 12% -> 3%
```

maya: initial improvement seen — p99 down to ~1.8s, p95 ~0.9s. Streaming stalls significantly reduced.

eva: preparing status page blurb. Proposed: "We are investigating increased tail latency affecting streaming responses; mitigations applied and performance improving. No data loss. We will update within 1 hour." Approve?

dylan: lgtm. add impacted customers list internally and note mitigation steps.

katie: starting rolling restart on kv-shard-12 pod ordinal 3 to defrag mem:
```bash
kubectl -n prod rollout restart statefulset/kv-shard-12 --selector=pod-ordinal=3
```

sanjay: restart done, pod came back healthy, readiness ok.

dylan: root cause hypothesis for postmortem: prefill-allocator change caused prefill workloads to colocate with decode threads more aggressively on certain hosts -> heavy prefill I/O and memory churn -> KV cache fragmentation and eviction storms -> decode requests occasionally block on KV prefill I/O causing tail latency and streaming stalls. Need stricter isolation between prefill and decode.

maya: short-term follow-ups: 1) leave PREFILL_ENABLED=false until next controlled deploy 2) lower prefill concurrency (config param PREFILL_CONCURRENCY 220 -> 40) 3) schedule config rollback or targeted canary for allocator.

eva: I'll send a customer note to AcmeCorp + BetaAnalytics with internal postmortem pointer and ETA for final update.

katie: adding a rate limit for background prefill in config now. Pushing PR to infra repo, will link.

dylan: put an incident marker in SLO alerts: mark p95/p99 regression window so burn is accounted properly.

sanjay: handing off monitoring to night on-call @julia — main ask: watch p99 and streaming_stall_rate, if p99 > 2s for >15m escalate to oncall. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/kv-prefill-tail-stalls

julia: ack — will monitor and escalate if it regresses. leaving a check-in in 30m.

maya: summary for now: mitigations applied (prefill disabled, decode scaled, kv pod restart). Observable improvement but monitoring for at least 2h. Posting incident notes to #incidents after we stabilize.

dylan: one more note — consider adding prefill CPU & IO cgroup limits in next infra sprint to avoid future interference.

incident-bot: Incident A-2026-3470 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned: eng-sre. Next update due 3470001860.

julia: I'll close loop after overnight monitoring. Thanks team. :pray:
